entries.title: Revelation of John 3:1
segments: ¶"And to the angel of the church in Sardis write, 'These things says He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: "I know your works, that you have a name that you are alive, but you are dead.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:2
segments: "Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die, for I have not found your works perfect before God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:3
segments: "Remember therefore how you have received and heard; hold fast and repent. Therefore if you will not watch, I will come upon you as a thief, and you will not know what hour I will come upon you.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:4
segments: "You have a few names even in Sardis who have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with Me in white, for they are worthy.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:5
segments: "He who overcomes shall be clothed in white garments, and I will not blot out his name from the Book of Life; but I will confess his name before My Father and before His angels.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:6
segments: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."'

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:7
segments: ¶"And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write, 'These things says He who is holy, He who is true, "He who has the key of David, He who opens and no one shuts, and shuts and no one opens":

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:8
segments: "I know your works. See, I have set before you an open door, and no one can shut it; for you have a little strength, have kept My word, and have not denied My name.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:9
segments: "Indeed I will make [those] of the synagogue of Satan, who say they are Jews and are not, but lie--indeed I will make them come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:10
segments: "Because you have kept My command to persevere, I also will keep you from the hour of trial which shall come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:11
segments: "Behold, I am coming quickly! Hold fast what you have, that no one may take your crown.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:12
segments: "He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of My God, and he shall go out no more. And I will write on him the name of My God and the name of the city of My God, the New Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from My God. And [I will write on him] My new name.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:13
segments: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."'

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:14
segments: ¶"And to the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write, 'These things says the Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of the creation of God:

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:15
segments: "I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I could wish you were cold or hot.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:16
segments: "So then, because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will vomit you out of My mouth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:17
segments: "Because you say, 'I am rich, have become wealthy, and have need of nothing' --and do not know that you are wretched, miserable, poor, blind, and naked--

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:18
segments: "I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined in the fire, that you may be rich; and white garments, that you may be clothed, [that] the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and anoint your eyes with eye salve, that you may see.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:19
segments: "As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten. Therefore be zealous and repent.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:20
segments: "Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him and dine with him, and he with Me.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:21
segments: "To him who overcomes I will grant to sit with Me on My throne, as I also overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.

entries.title: Revelation of John 3:22
segments: "He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches."'"
